To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the contact resistance between the wire and the top-side metallization is a more reliable indicator of the health of the power semiconductor than the collector-emitter resistance; and the contact resistance is also a good indicator of the lifetime of the power semiconductor, and can be used as a prognostic indicator.
wire—bond contact resistance can be used as an indicator to diagnose the state-of-health and prognosis of the remaining life-time of power module.
the bond-wire resistance can be used as a reliable indicator to diagnose and prognose the state of health of power electronics modules.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new method to diagnose the state health of the semiconductor power modules, based on the use of wire-bond resistance as an aging indicator.

a better understanding of the behavior of the contact resistance in the power module, its evolution and the influence of the aging conditions, in order to propose a new indicator of aging for the prognosis of the lifetime of power modules.
the use of wire-bond resistance to monitor the aging of the topside metallization of power modules.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the bond-wire resistance can be used as a more sensitive and reliable indicator for the degradation of the semiconductor power modules.
the contact resistance of the wire—bonds should be used as a health indicator of the power module, especially for online applications.
the contact resistance should be preferred to the collector-emitter resistance for monitoring purposes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the wire bond resistance should be used as an indicator of aging of semiconductor power devices.
the wire-bond resistance can be used as an indicator for the health state of a power module.
the bond-wire resistance is a very good indicator for the degradation of the power module and it is also very easy to measure and use online.
The main takeaway from our work is that

this indicator should be used to diagnose the state-of-health of the topside metallization of power module and that the degradation of this metallization is not correlated to that of the semiconductor devices.
the use of the bond-wire resistance Rb as indicator is much more suitable than Vce for the prognosis of the power module lifetime.
, for the first time, we show the possibility to use the bond-wire resistance to follow the degradation of power electronics modules and, consequently, to predict their remaining life.
